description: Start adding a property to Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet) from one of: listingUrl, a listing page on another website (the web app reads it: title, price, acres, the seller's description, photos, parcel number, county and state, and names the parcel); parcelNumber with state and county; or address. Finds the parcel and whether it is already on Fabrica. Signed in with the add-property grant, it then creates the property's record as the connected person, held by their linked account (wallet picks one when several are linked), with the listing's description and photos, and returns where it stands: the steps, and the questions the county asks for this property. Next the owner is asked who holds title on the deed and those questions, and answer_adding_questions saves them. Starting the same parcel again returns the existing record. Not signed in, or without the grant, it returns links.addToFabrica, the fabrica.land page that adds the parcel. Nothing is signed, paid or recorded by this tool: the fee approval and the notarized signature happen on fabrica.land.

address.description: The property's street address, with city and state

county.description: County name, with parcelNumber (and to narrow an address)

listingUrl.description: A listing page on another website (https link). The web app reads it: title, price, acres, the seller's description, photos, parcel number, county and state, and names the parcel.

parcelNumber.description: The parcel number (APN) as the county writes it; give state and county with it

state.description: Two-letter state, with parcelNumber (and to narrow an address)

wallet.description: Signed in with several linked accounts: the one that will hold the property. Left out, the only linked account is used.

name: add_land
title: Add a property to Fabrica
